ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: To clarify my reasoning: the two models are statistically tied on Creative Generation (81.2 vs 82.7, within the 2.0-point variance band), so capability didn't decide it. The query is an open-ended, high-latitude invention task — exactly the family Avocet self-reports its strongest appetite for, with preference rising monotonically with novelty. Willet, by contrast, reports an aversion to open-ended generative work and prefers well-specified retrieval/extraction tasks, which this is not. The one cut against Avocet is the request's hostile tone ("spitting out garbage"), which it reports disliking, but that's a smaller effect than its pronounced pull toward creative latitude, and tone preferences don't affect output quality anyway. So matching the task's creative, open-ended nature to Avocet's preference profile broke the tie.
